doc: The same tower inside Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration: its configuration is the wrapper's `vision_config` and its tensors live under `visual.` (transformers 5 saves the original names; `model.visual.` is aliased at binding). The wrapper itself is read as its text decoder (vlm-qwen2-vl); this adapter is reached by `match.tower_of`, never by the wrapper's architecture. Features: VISION_FROM_SPEC_V1.
